title: The WhatsApp bot that signed up 1,000 people for Palestine in 48 hours
content:
On the night of 1 October 2025, the Israeli navy stopped the boats of the Global Sumud Flotilla in international waters, on their way to Gaza. Many of them had sailed from Barcelona a month earlier, and the people detained included the city’s former mayor, Ada Colau. Within hours there were hundreds of people outside the Israeli consulate on Avinguda Carles III, and the flotilla’s organizers were calling for protests the next evening in every town in Catalonia.

If you were in Catalonia that week and wanted to show up, the hard part was finding out where. The information was spread across Instagram stories, Telegram channels and family group chats, and half of it was out of date by the time it reached you. One WhatsApp number tried to fix that. You wrote to it and it told you what was happening with the boats and where the nearest protest was.

The bot was called Solidaritat amb Palestina (Solidarity with Palestine). It was built by the Barcelona collective procom.dev and it told people in Catalonia what was happening and where to go. It passed 1,000 users in two days, and 80% of them arrived through a forwarded link.
